writer: Spring run/debug session F; session A reads this shared contract

transport.guestValue: JSON object, not JSON-in-a-string; no settings schema/persisted setting rewrite

launch.name: display label
launch.persisted: boolean; true only for a saved, non-temporary user config
launch.module: project-relative/absolute module | null (unknown); empty string means project root

profiles.values: string[]; [] with state known means explicit empty/default; unknown values MUST be []

launch.envFiles: configured paths only; do not read outside authorized current project
launch.unresolvedSources: subset of inheritedEnvironment, implicitJvmOptions, springApplicationJson, envFiles

known.value: string (production bridge permits non-sensitive literal true/false and validated spring.profiles.active / SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE profile names)

semantics: The host replaces the complete temporary context atomically per window/project and snapshots it per guest invocation. Raw launch args and environment values are never transported.

Transport context:null removes the temporary layer; it never writes or erases persistent plugin settings. Unset guest setting means no selected launch. Guest {version:1,launch:null} means conflicting/unknown selection and must not reuse previous launch facts.
The old springBeans.propertyOverrides persistent setting remains user-owned. This protocol is separate; do not put this object into the old JSON string envelope.

For persisted:true, the consumer should read only .openidea/run.toml and .openidea/run.local.toml inside the current authorized project and select EXACT configId (shared/project file wins duplicate IDs). Do not choose by name, main class or last-run config. Parse args/env/env-files in memory, never write their values to artifacts, logs, UI, screenshots or this contract. This uses the plugin existing project.read permission; do not expand third-party plugin scope.

Persisted live values may replace sanitized unknown Fact values only after the exact config was successfully found and its ID/kind/main/module/cwd and known facts match the selected reference. A missing, unreadable, mismatched or unsaved reference retains unknown facts; it must never borrow another config values.

Resolve effective precedence: command-line properties > Spring application JSON > Java system properties > explicit configured environment > env files > application config data. Extra implicit JVM options and inherited environment are unresolved sources, not enumerated here. Respect Boot config-data/profile processing and source completeness.

A Fact state unknown is a PRESENT high-priority override with an unavailable value. It blocks fallback for that key to lower sources. It is NEVER known absence, false, or the legacy user !key tombstone. Absence of a key in an incomplete source does not prove absence.

Repeated Boot CLI options combine values with commas. Profiles state known carries explicitly determined launch selection, not a claim that include/group/programmatic activation is fully known; consumer must account for those separately.

For unsaved configs, safe boolean Facts may resolve conditions; other values remain unknown unless independently available from authorized current project sources. Never permanently downgrade saved non-boolean application properties solely because the transport redacts their values.
Editor providers without window identity may consume matching facts only when all windows for a root agree; conflicts yield {version:1,launch:null}. Views retain window identity.
Known package aliases are matched by exact ID and actual enabled active/inactive status. Prefer stable fork ID; never call an arbitrary similar ID or guess an uninstalled package.

projectFiles..openidea/run.toml:
[[configurations]]
id = "user:dev"
name = "Dev"
kind = "spring-boot"
command = "java"
args = ["-cp", "${classpath}", "example.App", "--spring.profiles.active=dev"]
cwd = "launch work"
module = "app"
include-system-env = false
[configurations.env]
FEATURE_ENABLED = "true"

[[configurations]]
id = "user:prod"
name = "Prod"
kind = "spring-boot"
command = "java"
args = ["-cp", "${classpath}", "example.App", "--spring.profiles.active=prod", "--feature.mode=production"]
cwd = "launch work"
module = "app"
include-system-env = false
[configurations.env]

[[configurations]]
id = "user:precedence"
name = "Dev"
kind = "spring-boot"
command = "java"
args = ["-Dspring.profiles.active=vm", "-Dfeature.mode=system", "-cp", "${classpath}", "example.App", "--spring.profiles.active=prod", "--feature.mode=command"]
cwd = "launch work"
module = "app"
include-system-env = false
[configurations.env]
SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE = "dev"
FEATURE_MODE = "environment"

[[configurations]]
id = "user:stable"
name = "Dev"
kind = "spring-boot"
command = "java"
args = ["-cp", "${classpath}", "example.App", "--spring.profiles.active=dev"]
cwd = "launch work"
module = "app"
include-system-env = false
[configurations.env]

privacy: All examples are public synthetic values. No user environment/credentials are included. production payload must not contain synthetic-private-value, raw programArgs, VM options or complete inherited environment.
